data.action: 海滨贩卖机前比较冷饮性价比，坐到海堤边贴脸降温并偷偷得意
data.description: 圭穿着蓝灰色泳装外搭轻薄风衣，蹲在自动贩卖机前认真比较两种冷饮；她最终选择最划算的一瓶，坐到海堤边把罐子贴在脸上，蓝眼睛里藏着小小的得意。
data.lighting: warm afternoon light with cool can highlights
data.promptProse: Seated along the sunlit concrete seawall beside a coastal street vending machine on a warm afternoon, Kei wears her slate-blue one-piece swimsuit under a lightweight pale-grey zip windbreaker. Pressing a freshly chilled beverage can gratefully against her cheek to cool off, she looks sideways toward the viewer with a small, satisfied smirk over snagging the best bargain. Bright afternoon sun glints off the cool aluminum can and the sparkling blue ocean behind her.
data.title: 白银圭 · 海边自动贩卖机的冷饮选择
data.animaCaption: Seated along the sunlit concrete seawall in her slate-blue swimsuit and light grey windbreaker, Kei presses a chilled drink can against her cheek with a small, satisfied smile. Warm afternoon sun glints off the can and the sparkling sea behind her.
